transcript.t: Cathy, how do you remember so many English words?
I make flashcards. I write the word on one side and the meaning on the other.
Do you look up every new word in a dictionary?
Yes, and I also write a sentence with it. That helps a lot.
I just read the list again and again, but I forget the words.
Try reading aloud, too. It improves your pronunciation.
I will try it step by step. How many words do you learn a day?
About ten. Slow and steady works best.
